info.title: Talk Club API
info.description:
REST API of the Talk Club platform — the same API serves the web PWA, the admin and teacher
panels, and future native iOS/Android apps.

## Authentication
* **Clients** sign in with a phone number + SMS code (`POST /auth/otp/request` → `POST /auth/otp/verify`).
  New numbers receive a `registrationToken` for `POST /auth/register`. Email/phone + password
  (`POST /auth/login`) works for clients who set a password and for staff.
* Send the access token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (valid 15 minutes by default).
* **Web**: the refresh token lives in an httpOnly, SameSite=Strict cookie scoped to `/api/auth`.
  **Native apps** send `X-Client-Platform: native` and receive/send `refreshToken` in the body.
* Parents act for a child profile by sending `X-Acting-Client: <clientId>` on client endpoints.

## Errors
Every error has the same envelope: `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details?", "requestId" } }`.
`message` is safe to show to end users. Codes:

| Code | HTTP | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `VALIDATION_FAILED` | 400 | Please check the highlighted fields and try again. |
| `UNAUTHENTICATED` | 401 | Please sign in to continue. |
| `FORBIDDEN` | 403 | You don't have access to this action. |
| `NOT_FOUND` | 404 | We could not find what you were looking for. |
| `CONFLICT` | 409 | This change conflicts with existing data. Please refresh and try again. |
| `RATE_LIMITED` | 429 | Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again. |
| `INTERNAL` | 500 | Something went wrong. Please try again. |
| `AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS` | 401 | Incorrect login or password. |
| `AUTH_ACCOUNT_BLOCKED` | 403 | This account is blocked. Please contact Talk Club. |
| `AUTH_REFRESH_INVALID` | 401 | Your session has expired. Please sign in again. |
| `AUTH_OTP_INVALID` | 400 | The code is incorrect. Please check and try again. |
| `AUTH_OTP_EXPIRED` | 400 | The code has expired. Please request a new one. |
| `AUTH_OTP_TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS` | 429 | Too many incorrect attempts. Please request a new code. |
| `AUTH_OTP_COOLDOWN` | 429 | Please wait before requesting another code. |
| `AUTH_SMS_UNAVAILABLE` | 400 | Codes by SMS are not available yet. Please get your code in Telegram. |
| `AUTH_TELEGRAM_UNAVAILABLE` | 400 | Codes in Telegram are not available right now. Please use SMS. |
| `AUTH_TELEGRAM_NOT_LINKED` | 409 | Open the Talk Club bot in Telegram and share your phone number first. |
| `AUTH_SMS_COUNTRY_NOT_SUPPORTED` | 400 | Codes by SMS go only to Kazakhstan numbers (+7). Please get your code in Telegram. |
| `AUTH_SMS_SEND_FAILED` | 502 | We could not send the SMS right now. Please try again in a minute or get your code in Telegram. |
| `AUTH_SMS_DAILY_LIMIT` | 429 | Codes by SMS are paused for a while. Please get your code in Telegram. |
| `AUTH_CAPTCHA_REQUIRED` | 400 | Please confirm that you are not a robot. |
| `AUTH_CAPTCHA_INVALID` | 400 | The check did not pass. Please try again. |
| `AUTH_TOTP_REQUIRED` | 401 | Enter the code from your authenticator app. |
| `AUTH_TOTP_SETUP_REQUIRED` | 401 | Your role requires two-factor sign-in. Set up an authenticator app to continue. |
| `AUTH_TOTP_INVALID` | 400 | The code is incorrect. Check the time on your phone and try again. |
| `AUTH_TOTP_LOCKED` | 429 | Too many incorrect codes. Try again in 15 minutes. |
| `AUTH_MFA_CHALLENGE_INVALID` | 400 | Your sign-in has expired. Please sign in again. |
| `AUTH_PHONE_INVALID` | 400 | Please enter a valid phone number, e.g. +7 701 123 45 67. |
| `AUTH_PHONE_TAKEN` | 409 | An account with this phone number already exists. |
| `AUTH_EMAIL_TAKEN` | 409 | An account with this email already exists. |
| `AUTH_REGISTRATION_TOKEN_INVALID` | 400 | Your verification has expired. Please verify your phone again. |
| `AUTH_TERMS_REQUIRED` | 400 | Please accept the Talk Club terms to continue. |
| `AUTH_PASSWORD_WEAK` | 400 | Password must be at least 8 characters and include a letter and a number. |
| `AUTH_PASSWORD_NOT_SET` | 400 | This account has no password yet. Sign in with a phone code instead. |
| `CLIENT_PROFILE_REQUIRED` | 403 | This action is available for Talk Club members only. |
| `BOOKING_NO_ACTIVE_MEMBERSHIP` | 409 | You don't have an active membership for this session. |
| `BOOKING_NO_VISITS_LEFT` | 409 | Your membership has no remaining visits. |
| `BOOKING_MEMBERSHIP_EXPIRES_BEFORE_SESSION` | 409 | Your membership expires before this session. |
| `BOOKING_PLAN_NOT_VALID_FOR_SESSION` | 409 | Your membership cannot be used for this type of session. |
| `BOOKING_SESSION_FULL` | 409 | This session is full. You can join the waitlist. |
| `BOOKING_SESSION_CANCELLED` | 409 | This session has been cancelled. |
| `BOOKING_SESSION_STARTED` | 409 | This session has already started. |
| `BOOKING_CLOSED` | 409 | Booking for this session is closed. |
| `BOOKING_NOT_OPEN_YET` | 409 | Booking for this session is not open yet. |
| `BOOKING_ALREADY_BOOKED` | 409 | You are already booked for this session. |
| `BOOKING_OVERLAP` | 409 | You already have a session booked at this time. |
| `BOOKING_LEVEL_MISMATCH` | 409 | This session doesn't match your English level. |
| `BOOKING_CATEGORY_NOT_ALLOWED` | 409 | This group is not available for your profile. |
| `BOOKING_TRIALS_DISABLED` | 409 | Trial sessions are not available right now. |
| `BOOKING_TRIAL_NOT_ALLOWED` | 409 | Trial participants cannot join this session. |
| `BOOKING_TRIAL_ALREADY_USED` | 409 | You have already used your trial session. |
| `BOOKING_NOT_CANCELLABLE` | 409 | This booking can no longer be cancelled. |
| `BOOKING_LATE_CANCELLATION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED` | 409 | The cancellation deadline has passed. Please confirm that the visit will not be returned. |
| `BOOKING_OFFER_RESERVED` | 409 | The last seat is reserved for someone on the waitlist. |
| `WAITLIST_DISABLED` | 409 | The waitlist is not available. |
| `WAITLIST_SESSION_NOT_FULL` | 409 | This session still has free seats — you can book it directly. |
| `WAITLIST_ALREADY_JOINED` | 409 | You are already on the waitlist for this session. |
| `WAITLIST_OFFER_EXPIRED` | 409 | This offer has expired. |
| `WAITLIST_NO_OFFER` | 409 | There is no reserved place for you in this session. |
| `SESSION_INVALID_TIME` | 400 | The session end time must be after the start time. |
| `SESSION_ROOM_CONFLICT` | 409 | The room is already booked for another session at this time. |
| `SESSION_TEACHER_CONFLICT` | 409 | The teacher already has another session at this time. |
| `SESSION_CAPACITY_BELOW_BOOKED` | 409 | Capacity cannot be lower than the number of booked clients. |
| `SESSION_ALREADY_CANCELLED` | 409 | This session is already cancelled. |
| `SESSION_IN_PAST` | 409 | This session has already finished. |
| `MEMBERSHIP_NOT_ACTIVE` | 409 | This membership is not active. |
| `MEMBERSHIP_BALANCE_NEGATIVE` | 409 | The visit balance cannot go below zero. |
| `MEMBERSHIP_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE` | 409 | This membership is not available for purchase. |
| `PAYMENT_INVALID_STATE` | 409 | This payment cannot be changed in its current state. |
| `PAYMENT_METHOD_UNAVAILABLE` | 409 | This payment method is not available. |
| `PAYMENT_REFUND_EXCEEDS` | 400 | The refund amount exceeds the paid amount. |
| `PAYMENT_PROVIDER_ERROR` | 502 | The payment provider is not responding. Please try again later. |
| `PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_INVALID` | 400 | Invalid payment notification. |
| `PAYMENT_ALREADY_PENDING` | 409 | You already have a pending payment for this membership. |
| `ATTENDANCE_NOT_YOUR_SESSION` | 403 | You can only manage attendance for your own sessions. |
| `ATTENDANCE_WINDOW_CLOSED` | 409 | Attendance for this session can no longer be changed here. |
| `ATTENDANCE_BOOKING_CANCELLED` | 409 | This booking was cancelled. |
| `CHECKIN_DISABLED` | 409 | QR check-in is turned off. |
| `CHECKIN_TOKEN_INVALID` | 400 | This QR code is invalid or has expired. Ask the client to refresh it. |
| `CHECKIN_NO_BOOKING` | 404 | This client has no booking for a current session. |
| `FEEDBACK_DISABLED` | 409 | Teacher feedback is turned off. |
| `TRIAL_INVALID_STATE` | 409 | This trial cannot be changed in its current state. |
| `SETTINGS_INVALID` | 400 | Some settings values are invalid. |
| `IMPORT_INVALID_FILE` | 400 | The file could not be read. Please upload a valid CSV file. |
| `FILE_TOO_LARGE` | 413 | The file is too large. |
| `FILE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED` | 415 | This file type is not allowed. |

## Permissions
Admin endpoints list their required permissions in the 403 response description.
Default roles (editable in Admin → Roles):

* **SUPER_ADMIN** — Full access to everything, including roles and staff accounts.
* **ADMIN** — Runs the club day to day: clients, bookings, memberships, schedule, CRM and payments.
* **MANAGER** — Front desk: clients, bookings, schedule, attendance, payment requests and follow-ups.
* **TEACHER** — Own sessions, participants, attendance and feedback.
* **MARKETING** — CRM, segments, broadcasts and campaigns.
* **CLIENT** — Club member using the client app.

| `clients.view` | Clients | View clients and their profiles |

| `crm.view` | CRM | View leads, pipeline and tasks |

| `segments.manage` | Marketing | Create and edit custom segments |
| `broadcasts.manage` | Marketing | Create and send broadcasts |
| `announcements.manage` | Marketing | Manage announcements in the client app |
| `automations.manage` | Marketing | Manage automation rules |

| `schedule.view` | Schedule | View the schedule and sessions |

| `bookings.view` | Bookings | View bookings and waitlists |

| `attendance.mark_own` | Attendance | Mark attendance in own sessions |

| `trials.manage` | CRM | Manage trial lessons |
| `teachers.manage` | Resources | Manage teacher profiles |
